text:
mike: Heads-up — I'm opening a TF change to rename per-model runtime keys in the ConfigMap (moving from model_xxx -> models.model_xxx). Need quick sanity check before I merge, want to avoid breaking hot reload checks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821

yun: what's the intent? will the checksum change and trigger rolling restarts?

mike: intent is namespacing to avoid collisions when multiple customer overlays mount same cm. checksum will change—I've tried to keep the literal values the same but key paths change, so k8s will detect configmap change. I added an annotation to disable auto-restart for non-runtime keys.

yun: can you paste the TF snippet for the ConfigMap? want to see the merge strategy.

mike: ```hcl
resource \"kubernetes_config_map\" \"permodel_runtime\" {
  metadata {
    name = \"permodel-runtime\"
    annotations = {
      \"redwood.io/ignore-hotpatch\" = \"true\"
    }
  }
  data = {
    \"models.model_a.json\" = file(\"../models/model_a.json\")
    \"models.model_b.json\" = file(\"../models/model_b.json\")
  }
}
```

sre-oncall: @mike watch out: pods use checksum annotation `configmap-permodel-hash` computed by our sync controller; changing keys will update the hash and rollout. If you want to avoid full rollout, either fold changes into existing keys or update the sync to compute hash only over `data[\"runtime.*\"]` — but that adds complexity.

mike: good call. I added the annotation to signal sync to ignore non-runtime keys; see comment in PR. deploy-bot: PR #4821 — terraform plan OK? (auto message)

pr-bot: PR opened by mike: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821 — needs review from @yun and @sre-oncall

yun: quick ask — can we add a migration job that copies old keys to new names for a short window? otherwise some older dedicated clusters might still mount old key names.

mike: yeah I'll add a k8s Job in the same PR that runs once and copies data. pseudo:

```bash
kubectl get configmap permodel-runtime -o json | jq '.data |= with_entries(.key |= sub("^model_";"models.model_"))' | kubectl apply -f -
```

sre-oncall: that jq trick is fine but make sure it runs with the correct kubeconfig (staging first). Also add a timestamped backup of the original CM.

mike: will do. Plan: run job in staging tomorrow 10:30 PT, then prod after signoff.

yun: ping me once staging job succeeds + output logs. I can approve PR after.

mike: thanks all. I'll push change and add the migration job + backup step.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: staging 2024-04-03T17:30:00Z
